// PROGRAM STRUCTURE

How The 36 Works

A carefully engineered 4-step journey from discovery to ignition — built to surface the exceptional mind within you.

01
EXPRESS INTEREST
Parents or students fill the online Expression of Interest form. This signals intent and opens the door to the assessment stage. No payment at this stage.
02
TAKE THE MINIMUM ASSESSMENT
Applicants complete an analytical intelligence assessment covering: logical reasoning, pattern recognition, predictive thinking, data interpretation potential, and analytical intelligence. Only exceptional minds proceed.
03
GET QUALIFIED — RECEIVE YOUR BADGE
Qualified participants receive a confirmation, a unique numbered participation badge, and access to the cohort. Your badge number is your identity within The 36.
04
MAKE PAYMENT — ₦100,000
Payment of ₦100,000 is made ONLY after qualification and badge assignment. If you don't qualify, you don't pay. This protects every family's investment.
